notes: Single-stage but multi-step: parse canonical hexdump -C fragment dumps (8-digit absolute offsets, two-space group separator, ASCII annotation column), expand `*` repeat-collapse runs correctly against advancing offsets, place fragments by absolute offset from a shuffled manifest while ignoring decoy files, tolerate overlapping fragments and partial final rows, and reassemble a byte-exact x86-64 ELF that must actually execute and print a sentinel line. Hidden cases probe shuffled+decoy, overlap, heavy `*` runs, single-byte final row, and no-repeat variants; the verifier checks exact SHA-256 plus runtime stdout. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (offset-driven placement, repeat semantics), adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (five distinct dump layouts), quantitative_correctness (byte-exact sha + executable output), dependent_stages (reassembly -> execution -> captured output), debugging_ambiguity (partial rows and padding).
